inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: Report Change in Director: During the inspection it was found Kassandra Noriega is no longer the director and a new one has been employed.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Report Change in Director (26 TAC §746.303(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Written Activity Plans: The activity plan was not posted during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Activity Plans (26 TAC §746.2203(a))

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records: The director's record did not contain a date of hire, statement showing receiving a copy of the child-care center's operational and personnel policies, proof of request for background check, photo identification, driver's license, and verification of attending orientation.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records (26 TAC §746.901)

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Physician Information: Two of ten children's records reviewed did not have the name, address, and telephone number of the child's physician or an emergency-care facility.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Physician Information (26 TAC §746.605(10))

occurrences.finding: Transportation Safety Training -Director and Employee Complete 2 Hours Annually: One of two drivers had not completed the required two hours of transportation safety for their annual training year.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Transportation Safety Training -Director and Employee Complete 2 Hours Annually (26 TAC §746.1316(a))

occurrences.finding: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric first aid with rescue breathing and choking.: One of two caregiver records reviewed did not have a current CPR/first aid training.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric first aid with rescue breathing and choking. (26 TAC §746.1315(a))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - School Information for School-age Child: Six of ten children's records reviewed did not have the required name and/or telephone number of the school that the school-age child attends.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Special Needs Statement (26 TAC §746.605(13))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Transportation Permission: Six of ten children's records reviewed did not have permission for transportation.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Transportation Permission (26 TAC §746.605(8))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Date of Admission: Four of ten children's records reviewed did not have the child's admission date.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Date of Admission (26 TAC §746.605(3))

occurrences.finding: Posting Requirements - Prominent & Public: The required posting of the most recent licensing inspection, license, keeping children safe/parent notification, telephone numbers, and current employee list were not posted in a publicly accessible place where employees, parents, and others may easily view them.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Posting Requirements - Prominent & Public (26 TAC §746.403(a))

occurrences.finding: CPR Training and Recertification Adhere to Guidelines-skill based: One of two staff records reviewed for CPR training did not consist of a curriculum that included hands-on skill-based instruction.
occurrences.violation_type_title: CPR Training and Recertification Adhere to Guidelines-skill based (26 TAC §746.1315(b)(1))

occurrences.finding: Director Annual Training - Additional required topics: The director did not have annual training in required topics of Preventing and Responding to Emergencies due to Food or Allergic reactions, and Handling, Storing and Disposing of Hazardous Materials.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Director Annual Training - Additional required topics (26 TAC §746.1311(e))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Pediatric First Aid with Rescue Breathing: one staff member out of three staff members did not have CPR/First Aid training to review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Pediatric First Aid with Rescue Breathing (26 TAC §746.1301(a)(3)(A))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Health Statement: Four out of five children were missing health statements to review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Health Statement (26 TAC §746.603(a)(3))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Immunizations: Two out of the ten children files reviewed did not contain immunization records.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Immunizations (26 TAC §746.603(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - 30 Annual Training: The director did not have 30 hours of required training for the last full year of employment.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - 30 Annual Training (26 TAC §746.1301(a)(6)(A))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - School Information for School-age Child: Two out of the ten children files reviewed did not have the required name and telephone number of the school that the school-age child attends.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - School Information for School-age Child (26 TAC §746.605(14))

occurrences.finding: Posting Requirements - Prominent & Public: Required posting of evacuation plans, activity plans, recent 2936, keeping children safe/parent notification, telephone number, current employee list, child's food allergies, and license/renewal were not in a accessible and prominent place during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Posting Requirements - Prominent & Public (26 TAC §746.403(a))

occurrences.finding: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation: A volunteer was left unsupervised with children without the required fingerprints.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation (26 TAC §745.641)

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Transportation training: Both the director and the caregiver who transport children in care did not have transportation training available for review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Transportation training (26 TAC §746.1301(a)(7)(A))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Date of Admission: One out of the ten children files reviewed did not have the required admission date listed.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Date of Admission (26 TAC §746.605(3))

occurrences.finding: Required Equipment in Vehicles - Emergency Telephone Numbers for Each Child: Emergency contacts were not present on the busses when children were transported the day of the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Equipment in Vehicles - Emergency Telephone Numbers for Each Child (26 TAC §746.5617(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Annual Sanitation Inspection: Director was unable too provide an updated Health Inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Annual Sanitation Inspection (26 TAC §746.3401(a))

occurrences.finding: Training Criteria - Provided By: Staff trainings observed during inspection  were conducted by director who is not accrediated or qualifies to conduct trainings.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Criteria - Provided By (26 TAC §746.1317(a))

occurrences.finding: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months: The operation did not have a current fire inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months (26 TAC §746.5101(a))

occurrences.finding: Annual Sanitation Inspection: The operation did not have a current health inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Annual Sanitation Inspection (26 TAC §746.3401(a))
